customInstructions: Translate the page into English if it isn't already, using the site's language switcher.
If a server connection error appears at any point, this is a known transient issue with the site — simply reload the page and continue from where you were.
Choose the visit date from the available options — use the Date value given below.

In the 'Apartments, Royal Park and English Garden' section (NOT the 'Only Park' option), add the number of participants using the Pax count value below (all as full-price adults), select a time slot, and enter the Fiscal code value below into the fiscal code field.
Click the 'Tickets' button to proceed toward the final payment page.
Click 'Proceed with the Purchase'. If offered a 'Biglietto Sicuro'/'Ticket Safe' insurance add-on, decline it (choose the option that says you assume full risk / no insurance).

If prompted to log in or create an account, create a NEW account using the Email and Account password values given below, choosing the 'Individual' account type if asked. If asked for a fiscal code again during account creation, use the same Fiscal code value. If asked for consent/marketing checkboxes, decline/deny them.
Fill in guest details (first name, last name) and address using the values given below, using a placeholder address if the exact one given doesn't fit the form.
Continue toward the payment page and stop there — see the safety rule below.

finalAction.description: Proceed to the payment page and stop there

notes: User flagged that a real human doing this manually sometimes needs Firefox+incognito+VPN due to site quirks/anti-bot behavior -- omitted from agent instructions per the user's own note that it 'might not be necessary' for automation, but worth revisiting if every tool fails here in a way that looks like bot detection specifically (e.g. immediate blocks, CAPTCHAs) rather than normal task difficulty.
